## Où j'en suis
The SRE take-home exercise was created, scoped to 3 hours with Terraform and Docker Compose, and moved to a dedicated private repository to hide internal infrastructure history. The evaluation rubric was finalized without a strict pass threshold, and the exercise files were removed from the main infrastructure branch.

- [prochaine-étape] Send the private repository invite to the SRE candidate after the Thursday call.
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch Docker build with `--load` failed because the exporter does not support manifest lists; solved by building from source in Compose.
- [décision] The rubric will not use a cut-off score; scores are just input for the panel to decide (source: t10).
- [décision] The exercise must be sent manually after the call, with no automated emails (source: t16).
